verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents a built-in AI assistant, Composer, that takes a stated goal and builds the audience, drafts content and maps the send strategy. It can also make supported changes and carry work through with the user in control, and the pricing page lists delegable tasks such as scheduling recurring tasks, creating campaigns and flows, and answering data questions. The external MCP server is not credited here because it is not an in-product assistant. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation beyond marketing pages, independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as claimed, and a clear definition of which changes Composer supports.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Tell Composer what you're trying to achieve, and it'll build the audience, draft the content, and map out the send strategy.
Composer can make supported changes, build marketing for your review, and help carry the work through, with you in control.
Schedule recurring tasks ... Create campaigns + flows ... Get answers from your data
